snippet.title: Locked Inside - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
The horror game where you are an abandoned urban explorer who gets trapped inside a long-abandoned bunker deep in the woods. Now you have to find your way out of this place, but deep underground, the only thing awaiting you is unimaginable horror.

Wishlist the game now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4948380/Locked_Inside/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=trailer&utm_campaign=reveal_trailer
